en: The decks that win in Pokémon TCG Pocket tournaments {t0}right now{t1}, the {t2}latest events{t3} with their top 8, and a {t4}QR code{t5} for every list, so you can import a deck in a few taps.
How do I import a deck?
Open a deck, tap its QR code and save the image. In the game: {t0}My Decks → + → Scan Code → Scan Saved Image{t1}. On a computer, you can also point the game’s camera at the screen.
Where does the data come from?

Public Standard events with 8 or more players on {t0}Limitless TCG{t1}, from the last 7 days, because the meta changes fast (up to 14 days when there are few events, late in a set; never before the set’s release). The numbers are computed here, so they can differ a little from other sites.

en: The last 7 days. When there are few events (often late in a set) the page uses the last 10 or 14 days, so every number has enough players behind it. It never counts events from before the current set’s release, so in a new set’s first days the results are early ones. The line under the title shows the dates.

The tournaments of the same days, newest first. Open one to see the lists of its top 8 players, with a QR code for each. Events where players bring more than 1 deck are not listed, because they have no single list per player.
A player with at least 2 more wins than losses at a single-deck event.
What do “Unproven” and “No top result” mean?

The deck has no top player in these days. {t0}Unproven{t1}: some players won more than they lost, but none reached a top result; the page shows the best of them. {t2}No top result{t3}: no player won more than they lost; the page shows the best-placed list. Both are a starting point, not a proven list.

List 1 of a deck is the list that the most top players used. A list with only 1, 2 or 3 cards swapped counts with it: the tiles under the list show how many top players used it exactly or with 1, 2 or 3 swaps (tap a tile for those versions, each with its own QR code). A list with 4 or more cards swapped is shown as its own list when 2 or more top players used it, or 1 player finished in the top 8 of an event with 32 or more players. {t0}★ Popular now{t1} marks a list 1 that clearly more top players used exactly than any other list.
Why is the win rate different from other sites?
Mirror matches (the same deck on both sides) and events where players bring more than 1 deck are not counted. A tie counts as half a win.
Can I use it like an app?
Yes: tap {t0}Add to Home Screen{t1} at the bottom of the page for the steps.
Yes: no ads and no sign-up. No cookies and no personal data: the site only counts visits and button taps, anonymously (GoatCounter). This browser keeps only your theme and the last tab you used.
Feedback or a bug? {t0}Send me a message
